title: Leiden Historical Population Databank, 1700-1850, Census 1808 Leiden
descriptions: The dataset contains data taken from the census, held in Leiden in 1808. The dataset is a 20% sample of the original census source. The master thesis which is based on this dataset is available as a pdf document (in overig: “Leiden in 1808”, in Dutch).
